entities.name: Tirras
entities.description: A landlocked city in southwestern Jamuraa on Dominaria.

entities.name: Blue Mountains
entities.description: Mountains at whose foot Tirras lies.

entities.name: World Spell
entities.description: Spell that magically evaporated the Blue Mountains' glaciers.

entities.name: Johan
entities.description: Ruler of Tirras from the fortress of Krieghelm who waged Johan's War.

entities.name: Bryce
entities.description: City at the mouth of the Toloron.

entities.name: Palmyra
entities.description: Village of pirates and criminals halfway down the river.

entities.name: Johan's War
entities.description: War during which Tirras swelled with refugees and soldiers.

events.summary: The World Spell evaporates the Blue Mountains' glaciers, causing flash floods that nearly wipe out Tirras's tribes and later make the valleys fertile.
events.quote: Almost wiped out in flash floods

events.summary: During Johan's War the city swells with refugees and soldiers and its forest is logged for airships.
events.quote: During Johan's War , the city swelled with refugees, soldiers, traders, and scoundrels

events.summary: After Johan's death the Tirran elite squabble over rule and Tirras shrinks to a city-state.
events.quote: becoming a mere city-state once more

relations.note: Ruled from the fortress of Krieghelm.
relations.quote: During the reign of Johan , who ruled from the fortress of Krieghelm 400 years later
Tirras is a city in southwestern Jamuraa
